verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser documents a business immigration practice serving employers, including hospital systems, manufacturers, multinationals and startups. It has an employer-side compliance service for I-9 and E-Verify (audits, training, certification) and a business O-1 practice page, so company-side support is real. The specific sponsorship items in the story are not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented H-1B registration and transfer services, LCA/PAF compliance support, an explicit description of employer petition paperwork handling, and independent corroboration.
